# Hunch Board

> Hunch Board (hunchboard.dev) is the board file board.hunch: the system, the shape of the code and the screens, handed to the AI the person already uses.

- [Skill](SKILL.md): how to read and write a .hunch file
- [Example](examples/shop/board.hunch): a shop, one database, one flow
- [CLI](hunch.mjs): one file, Node 20 or newer. `node hunch.mjs check --json`
- [Site](https://www.hunchboard.dev): the board in the browser
- [Use it with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex](https://www.hunchboard.dev/use)
- npm package name: hunch-board
